title: Paystride Save Monthly Tier Review and Entry Gates
content:
The Paystride Save tier is reviewed on the first day of each calendar month against each tier's entry gate: payroll loads to the linked card in the previous calendar month and calendar days since the card's activated date. The account moves to the highest tier whose gate it meets; a move down happens only after 1 consecutive review below the current gate. Early wage transfers and instant pay disbursements never count as payroll loads.

## Entry gates

| Tier | Payroll loads to the linked card in the previous calendar month, at least | Calendar days since the card's activated date, at least |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Save Starter | $0.00 | 0 |
| Paystride Save Builder | $500.00 | 30 |
| Paystride Save Boost | $1000.00 | 60 |
| Paystride Save Growth | $2000.00 | 90 |
| Paystride Save Premier | $3000.00 | 180 |
| Paystride Save Elite | $4500.00 | 365 |

A gate is met when both of its figures are met.

## Review terms by tier

| Tier | When the tier is reviewed | Months below the tier's entry gate tolerated before moving down |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Save Starter | first day of each calendar month | 1 |
| Paystride Save Builder | first day of each calendar month | 1 |
| Paystride Save Boost | first day of each calendar month | 1 |
| Paystride Save Growth | first day of each calendar month | 1 |
| Paystride Save Premier | first day of each calendar month | 1 |
| Paystride Save Elite | first day of each calendar month | 1 |

## What counts as a payroll load

The payroll figure is the total of the payroll loads to the linked Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account in the previous calendar month. Early wage transfers and instant pay disbursements are not payroll loads and are left out of that total.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

| Previous month's payroll loads | Days since the card's activated date | Gates met | Highest tier whose gate is met |
|---|---|---|---|
| $1250.00 | 75 | Starter, Builder, Boost | Paystride Save Boost |
| $3200.00 | 120 | Starter, Builder, Boost, Growth | Paystride Save Growth (the payroll figure reaches Premier, the card days do not) |
| $499.99 | 400 | Starter | Paystride Save Starter |

A payroll total of exactly $500.00 with exactly 30 days since activation meets the Builder gate; $499.99 does not.

A move up goes to the highest tier whose gate is met at the review. A move down is subject to the downgrade rule: it happens only after 1 consecutive review below the current gate.
